decisions.reason: The DPA management tool fits the firm's compliance direction, sits close to the core offer, and has drawn positive agency feedback, so it meets aspirations at low cost and gives no reason for problemistic search.
As the flagship management platform anchoring the agency-focused strategy in a growing market, it is central to the firm's direction and would be kept even with early results still uncertain.
The configurable managed hosting plan extends the established business on existing infrastructure, and with industry turnover growing there is no performance shortfall that would trigger dropping it.

Extended PHP security support fits the firm's security and compliance promise and costs little, so slack lets the firm carry it while results are still unclear, though it may later be folded into standard plans as a minor add-on.
